approvers: Tax adviser, house bank, notary, family
reason: A higher multiple than the usual offers is interesting and a free confidential talk costs me nothing. But I have never heard of Always Broke Ltd, they have no earlier sellers, and my bank, tax adviser and notary would have to accept them.
objection: Who are these people, and will the money really be there at closing? A buyer with no track record and a name like that is a risk to my life's work and my staff.
instead: Keep the business and sell to a trade or management buyer, or list on nexxt-change at about EUR 375,000, or run it a few more years.
would_change_my_mind: My own bank and tax adviser confirming the funds and the directors, plus the full cash price paid at closing with a notary-secured contract.
